about_the_game:
Wujing was originally a great general of the Heavenly Roller Shutter, but was demoted to the Liusha River due to accidentally breaking a glass cup. Every seven days, he would suffer the pain of ten thousand swords piercing through his heart. As time goes by, Wujing's inner self gradually darkens. He no longer silently endures pain, but seeks to explore the truth behind the workings of this world in order to redeem himself.

Gameplay: Players decide their number of steps forward by rolling dice, and can spend money on building shops or other buildings in open spaces. In the store, players can purchase equipment to enhance their attributes, or purchase medicines to restore their unit status. When players encounter enemies, they will enter turn based combat.

Players can also spend reputation points on the Spirit Platform to obtain spirit beasts to help them fight. They can also purchase skill scrolls in the skill store for spirit beasts to learn skills, or purchase cultivation pills in the Spirit Treasure store to enhance their spirit beast attributes.

When the player's funds are less than or equal to 0, the game fails.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win10/win11
  • Processor: Intel I5 4690 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 / RX 480 (4GB+ of VRAM)
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: win10/win11
  • Processor: Intel i7 8700K / AMD r5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 2060 Super / RX 5700 XT (8GB+ of VRAM)
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Black Arhat: Wujing is a round game. Players will play the leading role of Wujing and start a wonderful adventure with the partners they meet on the way.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Korean, Turkish
